sentence: Scientists say that unless industrial ____ are cut by half before 2035, the temperature targets agreed in Paris will slip out of reach.
note: emissions 指工厂排出的废气；omissions 是遗漏、疏忽，commissions 是佣金或委员会，admissions 是承认或录取，都不指工业废气，也不能与 cut 搭配表示减排。

sentence: Analysts estimate that replacing the coal-fired heating plant with gas would cut the campus's ____ output by nearly a third within four years.
note: carbon output 指燃烧产生的碳排放量；oxygen 是氧气，nitrogen 是氮气，hydrogen 是氢气，三者都不是衡量供热系统排放多少的指标。

sentence: Having no oil, coal or gas of its own, the island now runs almost entirely on power that is genuinely ____, mostly from wind and small hydro plants.
note: renewable 指风、光、水等可再生的能源；recyclable 指材料可回收，reusable 指容器可重复使用，repairable 指物品可修理，都不修饰 power 表示能源类型。

sentence: Student activists are pressing the university to sell its shares in ____ fuel companies, arguing that it should not profit from the very industry it teaches students to criticise.
note: fossil fuels 指煤、石油、天然气等化石燃料；fertile 是肥沃的，federal 是联邦的，feudal 是封建的，都不能与 fuel 搭配指燃料类型。

sentence: Residents living beside the chemical plant complain that the ____ has grown so bad that the river below them no longer supports any fish at all.
note: pollution 指水体被污染的状况；population 是人口，possession 是拥有物，proportion 是比例，三者都不能用 bad 描述，也不会导致河中鱼类绝迹。

sentence: Biologists warn that draining the marsh would destroy the ____ of the region, wiping out dozens of insects and plants that are found nowhere else on earth.
note: biodiversity 指一个地区物种的多样性；biotechnology 是生物技术，biochemistry 是生物化学，biography 是传记，都不是抽干沼泽会破坏的自然属性。

sentence: When the last wolves were removed in the 1920s, the whole ____ of the valley shifted within a decade, as deer multiplied and stripped the young trees bare.
note: ecosystem 指生物与环境长期相互作用形成的整体；economy 是经济，ecotourism 是生态旅游，epidemic 是流行病，都不能指狼、鹿与树木彼此牵制的系统。

sentence: Spending on ____ takes most of the charity's income, which it uses to buy strips of land linking isolated woods so that animals can move between them.
note: conservation 指对森林、物种等自然资源的保护；conversation 是谈话，conversion 是转变，reservation 是预订或保留地，都与买地连通林地无关。

sentence: Satellite photographs show that ____ has slowed sharply in the past two years, mainly because farmers are now paid to keep the trees standing instead of clearing them.
note: deforestation 指大面积砍伐森林；devaluation 是货币贬值，dehydration 是脱水，desalination 是海水淡化，都不能与农民留着树木不砍的语境对应。

sentence: Three winters with almost no rain have left the wells dry and the pasture brown, and farmers are calling this the worst ____ in living memory.
note: drought 指长期缺雨造成的干旱；flood 是洪水，storm 是暴风雨，frost 是霜冻，都不会因几个冬天几乎不下雨而持续数年。

sentence: After four days of torrential rain the river burst its banks, and the ____ that followed carried away two bridges and forced hundreds of families to higher ground.
note: flood 指河水暴涨、淹没陆地的洪水；drought 是干旱，与暴雨决堤正相反；landslide 是山体滑坡，wildfire 是野火，都不由河水漫堤直接造成。

sentence: Road builders have agreed to build two wildlife bridges so that deer and foxes, whose ____ the new motorway has cut in two, can still reach the woods on either side.
note: habitat 指动物栖息的天然环境，这里指被新修公路切成两半的栖息地；habit 是习惯，inhabitant 是居民，habitation 指居住这一状态或住所，都不可能被公路“切成两半”。

sentence: The zoo's breeding programme is focused on ____ species such as the snow leopard, whose wild population is now thought to be below four thousand.
note: endangered species 指濒临灭绝的物种；dangerous 是危险的，endearing 是讨人喜欢的，enlarged 是扩大了的，都与野外数量不足四千无关。

sentence: Unless fishing in these waters is tightly controlled, scientists fear the species could be driven to ____ within a single decade.
note: drive a species to extinction 是固定说法，指使物种灭绝；distinction 是区别或荣誉，extension 是延长，exclusion 是排除，都不能与 driven to 搭配表示消失。

sentence: The new campus rules ask every canteen to ____ its cardboard boxes and plastic crates instead of sending them to the incinerator with the general rubbish.
note: recycle 指把废纸箱、塑料箱回收再利用；replace 表替换时须与 with 连用，restore 是恢复原状，reschedule 是重排时间，都与焚烧形成不了对比。

sentence: Nearly a third of the food bought in this country is thrown away, and most of it ends up in ____, where it rots and gives off methane.
note: landfill 指集中堆放垃圾的填埋场；landscape 是风景，landmark 是地标，mainland 是大陆，三者都不是食物腐烂并释放沼气的场所。

sentence: Because ____ takes hundreds of years to break down, every bottle that reaches the sea will still be there long after the person who dropped it has gone.
note: plastic 是常见包装材料中唯一需要数百年才分解的；cardboard 是纸板，timber 是木材，cotton 是棉，在自然环境中都会较快腐烂。

sentence: The vines that once ripened here every autumn no longer do so, because the ____ has warmed by nearly two degrees since the 1980s.
note: climate 指一个地区长期的天气状况；weather 是短期天气，不会说几十年间升高两度；temperature 习惯与 rise 搭配而非 warm；season 是季节，无所谓冷暖升降。

sentence: On the roof of the supermarket, a glass ____ now supplies the salad bar with herbs all winter, heated partly by waste heat from the ovens below.
note: greenhouse 指用玻璃采光保温、可以种花草的温室；warehouse 是仓库，farmhouse 是农舍，lighthouse 是灯塔，都不能在屋顶种植香草。

sentence: Measurements over Antarctica suggest that the ____ layer is slowly recovering, thirty years after the chemicals that were eating it away were banned worldwide.
note: ozone layer 指大气中的臭氧层；oxygen 是氧气，oxide 是氧化物，nitrogen 是氮气，都不能成层，也不会被制冷剂一类的化学品破坏。

sentence: Too many goats have grazed the hillside bare, so that little grows there now and every heavy rain washes more soil into the valley, in what scientists describe as serious ____.
note: degradation 指土地质量下降、退化；decoration 是装饰，delegation 是代表团或授权，dedication 是奉献，都不能描述过度放牧后水土流失的情形。

sentence: The ____ of fish stocks in the North Sea pushed several coastal towns into decline long before the catch quotas were finally introduced.
note: depletion 指资源被过度消耗而枯竭；completion 是完成，deletion 是删去文字，competition 是竞争，都不能解释鱼群锐减和渔镇衰落。

sentence: The dairy farm has covered its barn roof with ____ panels and now sells the surplus electricity back to the grid on bright afternoons.
note: solar panels 指靠阳光发电的太阳能板；lunar 与月亮有关，polar 是极地的，stellar 是恒星的，都无法与 bright afternoons 和发电量对应。

sentence: Each ____ in the offshore wind farm stands almost two hundred metres tall, and a single one can supply six thousand homes on a windy day.
note: turbine 指风力发电机；tunnel 是隧道，turnstile 是闸机，turntable 是转盘，都不会立在海上、高近两百米并为六千户供电。

sentence: The university has calculated the ____ of its new library, counting the concrete, the steel and the thousands of miles the materials travelled.
note: footprint 在此指建筑从建材生产到运输造成的环境足迹；fingerprint 是指纹，blueprint 是蓝图，footpath 是小径，都不能用混凝土和运输里程来计算。

sentence: The extra charge on long-haul tickets is supposed to ____ the damage the flight does to the atmosphere, but nobody can say how the money is actually spent.
note: offset 指用某种补偿抵掉造成的损害；outlive 是比什么活得久，outlaw 的宾语应是行为而不是 damage，outnumber 是数量上超过，都无法表示补偿。

sentence: Without ____, these fields would produce almost nothing, since the region receives less than twenty centimetres of rain in a whole year.
note: irrigation 指人工引水灌溉；irritation 是恼怒或刺激，isolation 是隔离，imitation 是模仿，都不是少雨地区让农田长出庄稼的手段。

sentence: Every winter the sea takes another metre of the cliff, and the council warns that this ____ will soon threaten the cottages at the top.
note: erosion 指岩石或土壤被海水、雨水一点点冲刷掉；corrosion 是金属锈蚀，explosion 是爆炸，exclusion 是排除，都不由海水逐年啃噬悬崖。

sentence: Beyond the last car park the path enters real ____, where no road runs for thirty miles and the only sounds are wind and birds.
note: wilderness 指无人居住、未开发的荒野，可以被“走进”；wildness 是野性这一性质，wildlife 指野生动物，willingness 是意愿，都不能这样用。

sentence: The island is home to more than two hundred ____ of birds, at least nine of which are found nowhere else on earth.
note: species 指物种，单复数同形，可说“两百种鸟”；spices 是香料，spaces 是空间，spheres 是球体或领域，都不能与岛上独有鸟类搭配。

sentence: Oil washed up on the shore does the most damage to ____ mammals such as seals and dolphins, whose blubber stops working once it is coated.
note: marine mammals 指海豹、海豚等海洋哺乳动物；maritime 指航海的或沿海的，submarine 指水下的，maternal 是母亲的，都不能直接修饰 mammals 表“海洋的”。

sentence: The factory was fined heavily after tests showed that ____ waste had leaked into the stream and killed every fish for two kilometres downstream.
note: toxic waste 指有毒废料，能毒死鱼类；tonic 是滋补的，tropical 是热带的，typical 是典型的，都不能解释下游鱼类成批死亡。

sentence: The hospital now sorts its ____ into five streams, so that gloves, glass, paper and food scraps each go to a different treatment plant.
note: waste 指可以按材质分类处理的废弃物；waist 是腰部，haste 是匆忙，taste 是味道或品味，都不能被分成五类送往不同的处理厂。

sentence: Cafés on campus have stopped handing out ____ cups, and students who forget their own mugs now pay a small deposit at the counter.
note: disposable cups 指用一次就扔的杯子，与自带杯子形成对比；dispensable 是可有可无的，desirable 是值得拥有的，dependable 是可靠的，都不表示一次性。

sentence: The festival's food stalls now use ____ forks, spoons and plates, all of which break down in the compost heap within about eight weeks.
note: biodegradable 指能被微生物分解；biological 是生物的，biomedical 是生物医学的，biographical 是传记的，都不能说明餐具能在堆肥中烂掉。

sentence: The ____ of clean water in the region has forced families to buy from tankers at ten times the price of the piped supply.
note: scarcity 指某样东西稀缺、供不应求；sincerity 是真诚，celebrity 是名人，similarity 是相似性，都不能解释人们花十倍价钱买水。

sentence: Untreated ____ from the town's drains runs straight into the bay, and bathers are warned to stay out of the water for two days after heavy rain.
note: sewage 指下水道里的污水和排泄物，未经处理会随雨水溢流入海；garbage、rubbish、litter 都是固体垃圾，不走下水道，也不用 untreated 修饰。

sentence: After a dry spring, the ____ behind the dam has fallen to a quarter of its capacity, and the city may have to ration water this summer.
note: reservoir 指拦坝蓄水的水库，可按库容算水量；reserve 是储备或保护区，resort 是度假地，residence 是住宅，都不能位于坝后并按容量计量。

sentence: The ____ inside the glasshouse stays above eighty per cent, which is why the orchids flourish but the gardeners change their shirts at noon.
note: humidity 指空气中的湿度，可以用百分比衡量；humility 是谦逊，humanity 是人类或人道，hospitality 是好客，都不会随玻璃房环境升到八成。

sentence: The ____ on the classroom wall reads thirty-one degrees, so the teacher has moved the afternoon class to the shaded courtyard.
note: thermometer 是温度计，能读出三十一度气温；barometer 是气压计，thermostat 是恒温器，用来调节而非读数，odometer 是里程表，记的是行驶里程。
